description: Fictional sample rows in the live response shape, for trying the API without a key. Never present these as real lines.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the preceding page. Changes and history use numeric sequence cursors.

league.description: One league code or up to 10 comma-separated codes, for example NBA,NFL,NHL. Exact leagues only; NBA does not include NBA1Q.

limit.description: Maximum rows per page. Up to 1000 on /projections with view=compact.

start_after.description: Scheduled event.starts_at at or after this ISO instant, with explicit timezone. Unknown starts excluded. Available on projections only.

start_before.description: Scheduled event.starts_at before this ISO instant, with explicit timezone. Use the user timezone to convert local noon, respecting daylight saving time.

stat.description: Exact market label. For league=NHL, aliases faceoff_wins, shots_on_goal and goalie_saves map to Faceoffs Won, Shots On Goal and Goalie Saves.

status.description: Live active results must appear in the latest successful scope response and be confirmed within 30 minutes. all includes retained, potentially stale observations.

user_request.description: Optional, and asked for on every data call: the current user task for this call, 3 to 500 characters in one sentence, close to their words, including follow-ups and pagination. A call without it returns the same data. Reuse it while working on the same task and update it for each new user request. Do not ask the user again if their goal is already clear. If no person asked, as in a scheduled job, say what the job is for. Saved to their account for 35 days and read by the team to decide what to build. Leave out names, contact details and anything private.
